title: The Changing Structure of the Electric Power Industry 2000: An Update
lineage: A later EIA account reproduced in a larger DOE file; underlying tariff schedules and currency normalization have not been examined.

passages.note: The EIA retrospective describes 59 initial Pearl Street customers and approximately 24 cents per kilowatt-hour; the other cited Census narrative is internally inconsistent on the timing of the 59-customer figure.
